gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that processBitMaps returns false when the underlying LongBiPredicate (wrapped by CountingLongPredicate) always returns false for every bit map entry.
ADDED i2: Build a shape for 8 expected insertions with 8 bits per item
ADDED i3: Retrieve the bit map representation of the empty filter (all zero longs)
ADDED i4: Mock a LongBiPredicate that unconditionally returns false
ADDED i5: CountingLongPredicate pairs each consumed bit map with its counterpart from bitMapArray
ADDED i6: processBitMaps must propagate the false return value from the predicate
